entries.182abed4f50f20e5: It sets out a purpose of “Creating financial wellness through the integration of FT (Financial Technology) and IT (Information Technology)” and a vision of “Becoming an innovator in financial services and asset management,” and aims to grow from a conventional systems development company into a Japanese-style digital asset management platform provider. Its medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years ended September 2025 through September 2027 sets five growth strategies: deepening and strengthening the customer base; reforming the business portfolio away from a revenue structure centered on life insurance companies; entering the family office business through subsidiary Wealth Engine; strengthening recurring business through the IFA platform of joint venture Trust Engine; and developing Southeast Asian markets.
